T.topic_fa: کوکاکولا بابانوئل قرمز را اختراع نکرد؛ فقط ۳۳ سال پشت سر هم همان یکی را کشید، تا دنیا اسمش را به نام کوکاکولا بنویسد
T.topic_en: Coca-Cola didn't invent the red Santa. It just painted the same one for 33 years, until the world gave Coke the credit
T.central_tension_fa: همه فکر می‌کنند کوکاکولا لباس بابانوئل را به رنگ برندش قرمز کرد. ولی بابانوئل قرمز دهه‌ها پیش از ۱۹۳۱ وجود داشت، حتی در تبلیغ یک نوشابه‌ی دیگر. کوکاکولا اولین نبود؛ فقط هر سال، ۳۳ سال، همان یک چهره را تکرار کرد. مالکیت با اختراع به دست نمی‌آید؛ با تکرار به دست می‌آید.
T.central_tension_en: Everyone believes Coca-Cola dressed Santa in its brand red. But red Santas existed decades before 1931, even in another soda's ads. Coke wasn't first. It was relentless: the same Santa, every year, for 33 years. You don't own an idea by inventing it. You own it by repeating it.
T.working_hook_fa: کوکاکولا بابانوئل را قرمز نکرد. ولی همه‌ی دنیا فکر می‌کنند کرد.
T.working_hook_en: Coca-Cola didn't make Santa red. So why does the whole world think it did?

key_sources.claim: Coca-Cola did not create the legend of Santa Claus; its 1931 Sundblom ads helped shape his modern look
Red outfits existed before; Sundblom's Santa ran in Coca-Cola ads 1931-1964 in major magazines, billboards, calendars, store displays
Red-suited Santa existed since at least the 19th century
White Rock used the modern Santa in 1915 and 1923 ads; Coca-Cola popularised him through repetition
Nast's 'Merry Old Santa Claus' (Harper's Weekly, 1 Jan 1881) credited with the red coat; Moore's poem never mentions red
Seasonal spark: Coca-Cola Holiday Caravan returns; 'share a Coke with Santa'

T.framing_note: Type 3 (secret behind a familiar brand). Safe claims only: red Santas existed decades before 1931 (Nast 1881, White Rock 1915/1923); Coca-Cola says itself it didn't create Santa; Sundblom painted Coke's Santa every year 1931-1964 (33 years); the myth that Coke 'made him red' is what the world believes. Do NOT claim Coke chose red to match its logo, and do NOT say Coke contributed nothing (it shaped the warm face and made him universal). One number on screen: 33 years. Lesson for business owners: you don't need to be first; pick one asset and repeat it until people can't imagine it without you. Never generate the Coca-Cola logo, Santa likeness from Sundblom, or any real face with AI; real ads only from owner uploads, framed and credited. Caption: sources + 'editorial use; images belong to their owners'. No UAE/Dubai/emirate anywhere. Owner uploads: T-b proves the red suit in 1902; T-a is Coke's 1930s Sundblom Santa; T-d shows the same Santa today. Sequence T-b (1902) -> T-a (1930s) -> T-d (today) carries the whole argument.
